title: Study Aid: AI Study Planner
description:
Study Aid – Learn Faster, Remember Longer

Study Aid is an AI-powered study planner designed to help students remember what they study using scientifically proven learning techniques including Active Recall, Spaced Repetition, Smart Flashcards, Revision Planning, Pomodoro Focus Sessions and AI-powered study assistance.

Whether you're preparing for school exams, college tests, competitive exams, entrance exams, or daily homework, Study Aid creates a personalized revision schedule so you never forget important topics again.

Unlike ordinary note-taking apps, Study Aid tells you exactly what to revise today using adaptive learning algorithms that improve long-term memory and knowledge retention.

Key Features

• AI Study Coach

Get instant explanations, summaries, quizzes, study plans and personalized learning recommendations powered by artificial intelligence.

• Smart Flashcards

Create unlimited flashcards or let AI generate flashcards automatically from your notes.

• Active Recall

Practice recalling information instead of rereading notes to improve memory retention and exam performance.

• Spaced Repetition

Automatically schedule revisions using scientifically proven spaced repetition techniques so you remember more with less effort.

• Revision Planner

Plan your daily, weekly and monthly study schedule with automatic revision reminders.

• Study Planner

Organize subjects, chapters and topics in one place and keep your entire syllabus under control.


• Exam Preparation

Perfect for:

✔ School Students

✔ College Students

✔ University Students

✔ NEET Preparation

✔ JEE Preparation

✔ UPSC Preparation

✔ SSC Preparation

• AI Study Assistant

Powerful Learning Features

✓ Smart Revision Calendar

✓ Study Analytics

✓ Learning Streaks

✓ Achievement Badges

✓ Exam Countdown

✓ Subject Management

✓ Chapter Management

✓ Topic Tracking

✓ Offline Access

Why Students would Love Study Aid

Instead of asking:

"What should I study?"

Study Aid answers:

"What should I revise today?"

Using Active Recall and Spaced Repetition, Study Aid helps reduce forgetting, improve memory retention and make every study session more effective.

Whether you're studying Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, History, Geography, Computer Science or any other subject, Study Aid becomes your personal AI learning companion.

If you're looking for a Study Planner, Flashcards App, Revision App, Homework Planner, Exam Prep App, AI Study Assistant or Learning App, Study Aid combines all these tools into one powerful application.

Download Study Aid today and transform the way you learn, revise and remember.
